usedFor: Pastel holds the client feedback projects and canvases, HubSpot holds the CRM records, and “New Project” can start “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in Pastel, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each new Pastel project opens a deal in HubSpot.

watchOut: “Update Company” in HubSpot needs a company ID, so match a Pastel “New Canvases” event to an existing company first.
